principle: Preserve original intent immutably; derive progressively more precise interpretations without replacing the source intent.

philosophicalAnalogies.Buber: agent-to-agent and human-to-agent relation is modeled as addressable I/Thou dialogue rather than anonymous state mutation
philosophicalAnalogies.Hofstadter: the same PMCR-O pattern may recur across macro, phase, child-agent, skill, and frame scales without widening inherited authority
philosophicalAnalogies.vonNeumann: validated patterns may reproduce as new bounded agents/skills/templates from explicit registries and checker evidence rather than copying uncontrolled state

notClaims: No claim that PMCR-O was derived from these philosophers or that other vendors derived from PMCR-O.
No claim that an interpretation is the user's hidden thought.

frameLaw.linguisticDependency: addressing another agent creates a traceable dependency edge, not an authority transfer

promotionRule: A recurring dialogue/procedure becomes a specialized child agent only when it owns independent state, grants, credentials, trail authority, or repeated validated capability boundaries.

bootstrapLaw.rule: PMCR-O may be applied recursively to the production of each PMCR-O phase product and to interpretation of prior thought frames.

metaReferenceLaw.rule: A meta-frame exists when the current subject-I takes a prior I/frame/cycle as an explicit object of interpretation.
metaReferenceLaw.nextIInstantiation: owning orchestrator may instantiate the next bounded I only from checked reflection and preserved source-intent lineage

thoughtTransferFlow: I1 bounded agent acts from interpreted intent
I2 reflector treats I1 plus its evidence as an object
I3 owning orchestrator consumes checked reflection and instantiates next bounded I
repeat while completion criteria and bounds allow
